verdict.rationale: Adyen documents risk lists (block and allow lists, or referrals) built from Adyen, merchant, or third-party data, plus custom lists and custom rules. A Referrals API automates uploading entries to block and trust lists, so list management is covered both in the risk profile configuration and programmatically. Velocity limits are never explicitly evidenced, and the specific list attributes (emails, cards, devices, IPs) are not enumerated. missing for 10: explicit velocity-limit rules, documented list types for email/card/device/IP, explicit dashboard list-management workflow, independent corroboration
